name: Delaware

response.rule_text: Public body must respond as soon as possible and no later than 15 business days by granting, denying, or advising that more time is needed for voluminous, legal-advice, or archived records, 29 Del. C. § 10003(h).

fees.labor_rule: Administrative fees may be charged for staff time beyond one hour (identifying records, monitoring file review, etc.), 29 Del. C. § 10003(m).
fees.copy_rule: Statutory fee schedule for photocopying and microfilm printouts, § 10003(m).
fees.waiver_rule: Agency may waive duplication fees in special circumstances, e.g. public interest.

residency.rule_text: Only Delaware citizens (including corporate citizens) may request, 29 Del. C. § 10001; non-citizens may not (Del. AG Op. 96-ib01).

appeal.body: Attorney General (petition) or Superior Court suit
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; a denied citizen may petition the AG, who determines within 20 days if a violation occurred, 29 Del. C. § 10005(e), or sue within 60 days of denial, § 10005(b).

notes: 60-day deadline is for suit (§10005(b)); AG petition deadline not found. Days read as calendar days. Governor's records subject to Act unless privileged. Legislature/universities/schools not confirmed. Silence-is-denial not confirmed.
